name_original: Lenovo - 23" IPS LED HD Monitor - Black
description_original: This Lenovo LED monitor includes a full-aluminum stand that lets you tilt the 23" display, so you can easily customize the viewing angle to suit your preferences. The 1920 x 1080 maximum resolution presents media in striking clarity.
